name: LookRecipe
tagline: Get an editable AI prompt from any web image.
description:
LookRecipe is a Chrome extension that turns a photo you see on the web into an editable AI prompt, without downloading the image first. Open it on a regular web page, hover over an image, and capture a structured photographic recipe: subject, wardrobe, light direction, setting, framing, lens, color palette and film grain. Switch between detailed, short and tag formats, add what to avoid, then copy the text into Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, ChatGPT image generation, or generate inside LookRecipe.

It is for people who already use text-to-image tools and want a prompt they can actually edit, not just a caption. Create a person card from one to five casual photos; LookRecipe keeps the face, hair and identity while applying the reference’s lighting, wardrobe and composition. Cards stay on your device so you can reuse them. You can also generate a coordinated 2×2 set—front, profile, a walking shot and a close-up—and upscale any frame later. A local inspiration library lets you collect images while you browse, then filter, download or export them as ZIP or JSON, with no sign-in required.

Installing LookRecipe and collecting images is free and needs no account. Sign in with Google to get 3 welcome credits; image-to-prompt analysis costs 1 credit, a single recreation costs 10, and an AI person card or 2×2 set costs 20. One-time credit packs start at $4.99 for 120 credits. There is no subscription, and credits never expire. Failed or cancelled jobs are not charged. Nothing is uploaded until you choose an image for cloud analysis. Cloud references are kept up to 30 days and generated images up to 90 days; collected media stays on your device.
